source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Can you confirm that our 5-week collaboration under the $160 trial includes all of the following?

Number of keywords: 48

ON-PAGE OPTIMIZATION

SEO Blogs: 9 articles

OFF-PAGE OPTIMIZATION: 420 backlinks

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text: Review the attached keyword list and provide your approval so I can proceed.

execution.observed_behavior: The agency reports supplying the initial keyword list for client review.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Because the keyword report currently omits search volume, could you add that data for the listed keywords?

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text: I’ve now added both the keyword and its search volume; please review the updated material.

execution.observed_behavior: The agency reports adding search-volume information to the keyword material.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Use custom keepsake inspiration as the replacement for this keyword.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For this keyword, use knitted animals instead.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For this keyword, use artisan plush toys instead.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For this keyword, use woven bouquet instead.

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text: All requested changes are now reflected in my sheet.

execution.observed_behavior: The agency reports applying the requested keyword replacements to the sheet.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For the referenced keyword, use comfort companion plush toy instead.

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text: The final keyword sheet has been supplied; please review it.

execution.observed_behavior: The agency reports supplying the revised final keyword sheet.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Search volume is still missing from the keyword sheet; could you add it?

execution.observed_behavior: Client review of the supplied final keyword sheet found that the required search-volume data was still missing.

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text: Please review the updated sheet, which now includes keyword volume information.

execution.observed_behavior: The agency reports correcting the sheet to include keyword search-volume information.
